function cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

    nthread_per_block = 256

# Compare the atomic lowering against the reduction lowering on device,
# same inputs, for every stress subject and every trip count that matters.
# n = 0 is the one that decides whether the default can flip: a reduction
# over an empty view must contribute zero, not raise.
function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
    z(n) = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    mk(n) = CUDA.CuArray(collect(1.0:max(n,1)) ./ max(n,1))

    function pair(name, f_at, f_re, nargs, n)
        u = mk(n); v = mk(n); w = mk(n)
        out = Dict{String,Any}()
        for (tag, f) in (("atom", f_at), ("red", f_re))
            loss = z(1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float64, 1)
            ub = z(max(n,1)); vb = z(max(n,1)); wb = z(max(n,1))
            try
                if nargs == 1
                    f(loss, lossb, u, ub, n)
                elseif nargs == 2
                    f(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, n)
                else
                    f(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, w, wb, n)
                end
                CUDA.synchronize()
                out[tag] = Array(loss)[1]
                out[tag * "_ub"] = sum(Array(ub))
            catch e
                out[tag] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 110)
            end
        end
        if out["atom"] isa Number && out["red"] isa Number
            d = max(abs(out["atom"]), 1.0)
            out["rel_err"] = abs(out["red"] - out["atom"]) / d
            out["ub_rel_err"] = abs(out["red_ub"] - out["atom_ub"]) / max(abs(out["atom_ub"]), 1.0)
        end
        r["$(name)_n$(n)"] = out
        return nothing
    end

    for n in (0, 1, 4, 7)
        pair("dotprod",         dotprod_atom,         dotprod_red,         2, n)
        pair("partialdot",      partialdot_atom,      partialdot_red,      2, n)
        pair("single_cube",     red_single_cube_atom, red_single_cube_red, 1, n)
        pair("three_arrays",    red_three_arrays_atom,red_three_arrays_red,3, n)
        pair("subtract",        red_subtract_atom,    red_subtract_red,    2, n)
        pair("reverse",         red_reverse_atom,     red_reverse_red,     2, n)
        pair("strided",         red_strided_atom,     red_strided_red,     2, n)
    end
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
